repair.repair.paths.must.stay.within.pro.zh: 修复路径必须是项目源码，不能指向用户数据或目录之外
repair.repair.paths.must.stay.within.pro.en: Repair paths must stay within project source and must not target user data

repair.the.repair.path.links.outside.the.zh: 修复路径的链接指向项目之外
repair.the.repair.path.links.outside.the.en: The repair path links outside the project

repair.read.the.error.and.source.then.ca.zh: 先读取错误和源码，调用 investment_repair_plan 展示完整修复方案；用户确认前禁止改文件、执行 shell 或委派修复
repair.read.the.error.and.source.then.ca.en: Read the error and source, then call investment_repair_plan with the full plan. Do not edit, run shell commands or delegate repairs before user approval.

repair.repairs.may.execute.only.the.appr.zh: 修复仅允许当前对话执行已确认的文件修改和命令，不能委派或启动替代工作流
repair.repairs.may.execute.only.the.appr.en: Repairs may execute only the approved file changes and commands in this conversation. Do not delegate or start another workflow.

repair.this.command.is.outside.the.appro.zh: 命令不在已确认方案内，请更新方案并重新确认
repair.this.command.is.outside.the.appro.en: This command is outside the approved plan. Update the plan and obtain approval again.

repair.repair.commands.must.finish.in.th.zh: 修复命令必须在前台完成并取得退出码
repair.repair.commands.must.finish.in.th.en: Repair commands must finish in the foreground with an exit code

repair.repair.commands.must.explicitly.s.zh: 修复命令必须用绝对路径明确指定已确认的项目根目录作为 workdir
repair.repair.commands.must.explicitly.s.en: Repair commands must explicitly set workdir to the approved absolute project root

repair.repair.files.must.use.approved.ab.zh: 修复文件必须使用已确认源码的绝对路径，不能依赖会话工作目录
repair.repair.files.must.use.approved.ab.en: Repair files must use approved absolute paths rather than the session working directory

repair.this.file.is.outside.the.approved.zh: 文件不在已确认方案内，请更新方案并重新确认
repair.this.file.is.outside.the.approved.en: This file is outside the approved plan. Update the plan and obtain approval again.

repair.too.many.repair.operations.stoppe.zh: 本次修复操作过多，已停止，请报告结果后重新提出方案
repair.too.many.repair.operations.stoppe.en: Too many repair operations; stopped. Report results before proposing another plan.

repair.present.a.diagnosed.product.repai.zh: 展示产品修复方案并等待用户确认。必须先诊断；确认前不修改源码。确认只授权列明的文件和命令，失败后停止，不自动重跑原分析。
repair.present.a.diagnosed.product.repai.en: Present a diagnosed product repair plan and wait for user approval. Approval covers only listed files and commands. Stop on failure; do not restart the original analysis automatically.

repair.repair.approval.is.available.only.zh: 修复确认只能在用户桌面对话中进行，后台只报告错误并停止
repair.repair.approval.is.available.only.en: Repair approval is available only in the user's desktop conversation. Background tasks must report errors and stop.

repair.product.source.root.is.missing.re.zh: 缺少产品源码根目录，不能确定修复范围
repair.product.source.root.is.missing.re.en: Product source root is missing; repair scope cannot be determined

repair.repair.plan.is.missing.a.valid.en: Repair plan is missing a valid

repair.validation.commands.must.also.be..zh: 验证命令必须列在允许执行的命令内
repair.validation.commands.must.also.be..en: Validation commands must also be listed among allowed commands

repair.no.user.approval.channel.is.avail.zh: 当前对话没有用户确认通道，修复保持停止
repair.no.user.approval.channel.is.avail.en: No user approval channel is available; repair remains stopped

repair.execute.only.the.listed.changes.a.zh: 只执行列明的修改和命令，完成后报告验证结果。
repair.execute.only.the.listed.changes.a.en: Execute only the listed changes and commands, then report validation results.

repair.keep.stopped.and.revise.the.plan..en: Keep stopped and revise the plan first.

repair.user.approval.was.not.given.repai.zh: 用户未确认，修复保持停止
repair.user.approval.was.not.given.repai.en: User approval was not given; repair remains stopped

repair.source.changed.while.awaiting.app.zh: 方案确认期间源码已变化，请重新诊断并确认
repair.source.changed.while.awaiting.app.en: Source changed while awaiting approval. Diagnose again and request a new approval.

repair.use.the.absolute.file.paths.and.w.zh: 文件和 workdir 使用上述绝对路径；仅执行确认范围，验证失败立即停止。完成后调用 investment_repair_finish，不自动重跑原分析。
repair.use.the.absolute.file.paths.and.w.en: Use the absolute file paths and workdir above. Stay within the approved scope and stop on validation failure. Call investment_repair_finish afterward. Do not restart the original analysis automatically.

repair.close.the.repair.grant.and.report.zh: 关闭本次修复并报告结果。成功必须有实际执行通过的全部验证命令；失败立即关闭授权并报告，不能继续自动修复或重跑分析。
repair.close.the.repair.grant.and.report.en: Close the repair grant and report results. Success requires all validation commands to pass. On failure, revoke the grant and stop; do not continue repairs or restart analysis.

repair.this.conversation.has.no.matching.zh: 当前对话没有对应的修复授权
repair.this.conversation.has.no.matching.en: This conversation has no matching repair grant

repair.repair.operations.are.still.runni.zh: 修复操作尚未结束，不能宣布验证完成
repair.repair.operations.are.still.runni.en: Repair operations are still running; validation cannot be declared complete

repair.not.all.validation.commands.passe.zh: 没有取得当前源码下全部验证命令的成功退出码，不能宣布修复成功
repair.not.all.validation.commands.passe.en: Not all validation commands passed against the current source; repair success cannot be declared

repair.the.repair.grant.is.closed.report.zh: 修复授权已关闭。请向用户报告结果；原分析续跑仍需用户明确要求。
repair.the.repair.grant.is.closed.report.en: The repair grant is closed. Report results to the user. Resuming the original analysis still requires an explicit user request.

research.incomplete.zh: 基础研究未达到完整性阈值，按故障安全规则保持持仓。
research.incomplete.en: Base research did not meet completeness requirements; retain the position under fail-safe rules.

research.notSubmitted.zh: 本次仅生成研究方案，未进入模拟撮合
research.notSubmitted.en: Research generated only; no paper orders were submitted

workflow.and.this.security.has.positive..zh: %，且该标的 EV 为正，按授权书标准仓位部署。这项是分析建议，不构成硬性交易。
workflow.and.this.security.has.positive..en: %, and this security has positive EV. Allocate the mandate's standard position. This is an analysis recommendation, not a mandatory trade.

workflow.exceeds.the.target.ceiling.the..zh: % 高于目标上限，组合不得全现金；按最低部署 25% 与单票上限执行。这项是分析建议，不构成硬性交易。
workflow.exceeds.the.target.ceiling.the..en: % exceeds the target ceiling; the portfolio should not remain entirely in cash. Apply minimum 25% deployment and per-security limits. This is an analysis recommendation, not a mandatory trade.

workflow.required.stage.roles.returned.i.zh: 阶段必要角色结果不完整：
workflow.required.stage.roles.returned.i.en: Required stage roles returned incomplete results:

workflow.conflicting.evidence.id.in.brie.zh: 简洁论据存在冲突证据编号：

workflow.the.researchbriefs.experiment.r.zh: researchBriefs 试验需关闭其他角色、去重、输出与工具策略试验
workflow.the.researchbriefs.experiment.r.en: The researchBriefs experiment requires other role, deduplication, output and tool-policy experiments to be disabled

workflow.the.selectivefastthinking.exper.zh: selectiveFastThinking 试验需关闭其他角色、去重、输出与工具策略试验
workflow.the.selectivefastthinking.exper.en: The selectiveFastThinking experiment requires other role, deduplication, output and tool-policy experiments to be disabled

workflow.market.must.be.cn.hk.us.or.etf.zh: market 必须是 cn、hk、us 或 etf
workflow.market.must.be.cn.hk.us.or.etf.en: market must be cn, hk, us or etf

workflow.a.manual.conversation.cannot.su.zh: 手动对话不能直接提交；请先展示方案并取得用户确认，再使用受控提交工具
workflow.a.manual.conversation.cannot.su.en: A manual conversation cannot submit directly. Present the plan and obtain user approval before using the controlled submission tool.

workflow.manual.analysis.requires.explic.zh: 手动分析必须明确标的：请先运行选股（investment_run_screening / investment_screening）得到标准化候选列表，再把结果以 symbols 传入本工具（symbols_source="screening"）；用户点名的股票直接以 symbols 传入（symbols_source="user"）。本入口不允许空股票列表。
workflow.manual.analysis.requires.explic.en: Manual analysis requires explicit securities. Screen first with investment_run_screening / investment_screening, then pass the standardized symbols with symbols_source="screening". Pass user-selected securities with symbols_source="user". Empty security lists are not permitted.

workflow.this.round.failed.and.was.not.r.zh: 该轮次失败且未重启。先报告原错误；只有用户明确要求时才传同一 cycle_id 和 retry=true 续跑。
workflow.this.round.failed.and.was.not.r.en: This round failed and was not restarted. Report the original error. Resume with the same cycle_id and retry=true only when the user explicitly requests it.

workflow.this.round.was.stopped.its.orig.zh: 该轮次已停止；原 cycle_id 不重启。
workflow.this.round.was.stopped.its.orig.en: This round was stopped; its original cycle_id will not restart.

workflow.do.not.restart.or.reimplement.t.zh: ") 查询进度；不要重复启动或自行重写分析。
workflow.do.not.restart.or.reimplement.t.en: "). Do not restart or reimplement the analysis.

workflow.a.valid.dsh.session.is.required.zh: 全流程分析需要从一个有效的 DSH 会话调用
workflow.a.valid.dsh.session.is.required.en: A valid DSH session is required for the full analysis workflow

workflow.the.background.round.timed.out..zh: 后台轮次已超时，检查点保留；禁止重新启动研究
workflow.the.background.round.timed.out..en: The background round timed out. Checkpoints are retained; restarting research is prohibited.

workflow.the.engine.is.paused.or.emergen.zh: 引擎已暂停或紧急停止，分析轮次未启动
workflow.the.engine.is.paused.or.emergen.en: The engine is paused or emergency-stopped; no analysis round was started

workflow.targets.came.from.screening.and.zh: 目标来自选股结果，持仓仅作为组合背景，不扩充研究名单。
workflow.targets.came.from.screening.and.en: Targets came from screening. Existing holdings remain portfolio context and do not expand the research list.

workflow.targets.were.explicitly.selecte.en: Targets were explicitly selected by the caller (

workflow.screening.and.holdings.are.empt.en: No research candidates were selected. Review the screening result.

workflow.submit.the.saved.final.decision.zh: 使用已保存的最终决策完成本轮模拟提交
workflow.submit.the.saved.final.decision.en: Submit the saved final decisions for this paper round

workflow.the.brief.contract.cannot.chang.zh: 不能在同一轮次中切换简洁论据契约；请使用新的 cycle_id
workflow.the.brief.contract.cannot.chang.en: The brief contract cannot change within a round. Use a new cycle_id.

workflow.the.research.thinking.policy.ca.zh: 不能在同一轮次中切换研究思考档位策略；请使用新的 cycle_id
workflow.the.research.thinking.policy.ca.en: The research thinking policy cannot change within a round. Use a new cycle_id.

workflow.brief.archive.is.missing.or.acc.zh: 简洁论据归档缺失或账户/授权书已变化；请使用新的 cycle_id
workflow.brief.archive.is.missing.or.acc.en: Brief archive is missing or account/mandate changed. Use a new cycle_id.

workflow.completed.stage.brief.archives..zh: 已完成阶段的简洁论据归档不完整；请使用新的 cycle_id
workflow.completed.stage.brief.archives..en: Completed-stage brief archives are incomplete. Use a new cycle_id.

workflow.account.or.mandate.changed.the..zh: 账户或授权书已变化，不能复用旧轮次的裁决；请使用新的 cycle_id 重新分析
workflow.account.or.mandate.changed.the..en: Account or mandate changed; the old verdict cannot be reused. Analyze again with a new cycle_id.

workflow.full.research.archives.are.miss.zh: 本轮完整研究归档缺失，不能无损续跑；请在用户对话中处理
workflow.full.research.archives.are.miss.en: Full research archives are missing; lossless resume is unavailable. Resolve this in the user's conversation.

workflow.shared.original.research.materi.zh: 本轮共享原始资料归档缺失，不能无损续跑；请使用新的 cycle_id
workflow.shared.original.research.materi.en: Shared original research material is missing; lossless resume is unavailable. Use a new cycle_id.

workflow.shared.evidence.archive.was.not.zh: 共享取证归档未写入；本轮数据追溯不完整
workflow.shared.evidence.archive.was.not.en: Shared evidence archive was not written; traceability is incomplete

workflow.shared.evidence.archive.request.zh: 共享取证归档接口失败；本轮数据追溯不完整
workflow.shared.evidence.archive.request.en: Shared evidence archive request failed; traceability is incomplete

workflow.fail.safe.rules.block.submissio.en: ; fail-safe rules block submission for this round

workflow.base.research.incomplete.forced.zh: 基础研究不完整，已强制 HOLD

workflow.base.research.incomplete.exclud.zh: 基础研究不完整，已从候选决策排除
workflow.base.research.incomplete.exclud.en: base research incomplete; excluded from candidate decisions

workflow.full.multi.role.analysis.comple.zh: 全流程多角色分析完成

workflow.no.analysis.rounds.yet.start.th.zh: 尚无分析轮次记录；请先调用 investment_analysis_workflow 启动固定流程
workflow.no.analysis.rounds.yet.start.th.en: No analysis rounds yet. Start the fixed workflow with investment_analysis_workflow.

workflow.analysis.completed.ready.for.ex.zh: 分析已完成（ready_for_execution）。把最终决策清单呈现给用户并等待明确批准；批准后用 investment_submit_decisions 原样提交，idempotency_key 必须等于本轮的 cycle_id（
workflow.analysis.completed.ready.for.ex.en: Analysis completed (ready_for_execution). Present the exact final decisions and wait for explicit approval. Then submit them unchanged with investment_submit_decisions; idempotency_key must equal this round's cycle_id (

workflow.check.again.later.with.this.too.zh: ）。稍后再次调用本工具查询，不要重复启动轮次。
workflow.check.again.later.with.this.too.en: ). Check again later with this tool; do not start a duplicate round.

workflow.saved.checkpoints.are.retained..zh: 。已保存的检查点保留；先报告错误，只有用户明确要求时才用同一 cycle_id 和 retry=true 续跑。后台不得自行修复或重跑。
workflow.saved.checkpoints.are.retained..en: . Saved checkpoints are retained. Report the error first; resume with the same cycle_id and retry=true only on explicit user request. Background tasks must not repair or restart themselves.

workflow.round.stopped.start.a.new.round.en: Round stopped. Start a new round if a new analysis is needed.
